```python
import os, glob
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

# 1) Locate the dataset
candidates = []
for pattern in ["**/titanic*.csv", "**/titanic*.tsv"]:
    candidates += glob.glob(pattern, recursive=True)
candidates = sorted(set(candidates))
print("Candidates found:", candidates)
print("CWD:", os.getcwd())

if not candidates:
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        "titanic.csv not found. Available CSVs at top levels:\n"
        + "\n".join(sorted(glob.glob('**/*.csv', recursive=True))[:50])
    )

DATA_PATH = candidates[0]
df = read_df(DATA_PATH)
print("\nLoaded:", DATA_PATH, "| shape:", df.shape)
```

candidates = []
for pattern in ["**/titanic*.csv", "**/titanic*.tsv"]:
    candidates += glob.glob(pattern, recursive=True)
candidates = sorted(set(candidates))
print("Candidates found:", candidates)
print("CWD:", os.getcwd())

if not candidates:
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        "titanic.csv not found. Available CSVs:\n"
        + "\n".join(sorted(glob.glob('**/*.csv', recursive=True))[:50])
    )

DATA_PATH = candidates[0]
df = read_df(DATA_PATH)
print("\nLoaded:", DATA_PATH, "| shape:", df.shape)

# 2) Identify binary target
target_candidates = [c for c in df.columns if c.lower() in ("survived", "target", "label")]
print("\nTarget candidates:", target_candidates)
TARGET = target_candidates[0]
print("Using target:", TARGET)
print("\nTarget distribution:")
print(df[TARGET].value_counts(dropna=False))
print("Target missing:", df[TARGET].isna().sum())

# 3) Freeze splits: 60/20/20 stratified on target, fixed seed
SEED = 42
df_train, df_temp = train_test_split(
    df, test_size=0.40, random_state=SEED, stratify=df[TARGET]
)
df_val, df_test = train_test_split(
    df_temp, test_size=0.50, random_state=SEED, stratify=df_temp[TARGET]
)

print(f"\nSEED = {SEED}")
print("train:", df_train.shape, "| val:", df_val.shape, "| test:", df_test.shape)
print("Total check:", len(df_train) + len(df_val) + len(df_test), "==", len(df))

for name, part in [("train", df_train), ("val", df_val), ("test", df_test)]:
    print(f"\n{name} target rate:")
    print(part[TARGET].value_counts(normalize=True).round(4))
